item.description: The get_domain_separator function incorrectly handles EIP-712 domain separator calculation. It's not producing the expected hash values for the test cases, suggesting issues with the type hash calculation or domain data encoding according to EIP-712 standards.
item.contract: Fix the EIP-712 domain separator calculation to match the expected test values. The function should properly compute the domain separator using keccak256("EIP712Domain(...)" + keccak256(name) + keccak256(version) + chainId + verifyingContract) where all values are properly encoded with 32-byte padding.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/ctc/binary/test_eip712.py should pass with both test0 and test1 cases.

item.description: The sign_transaction function doesn't correctly handle transaction serialization and signing for EIP-1559 transactions, causing signature mismatches with the test expectations. The transaction serialization logic has issues with field mapping and EIP-1559 transaction format handling.
item.contract: Correct the transaction serialization and signing logic to properly handle EIP-1559 transactions (type 2) according to EIP-1559 standards. Ensure that the transaction is properly formatted with all required fields and that the signing process correctly computes the signature.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/ctc/evm/test_transaction_utils/test_transaction_utils.py should pass for both test0 and test1 cases in test_sign_transaction.

item.description: The sign_text_message function isn't correctly handling message prefixes for personal_sign mode, causing signature mismatches. The message hashing for personal_sign mode needs to correctly apply the Ethereum Signed Message prefix.
item.contract: Fix the message prefixing for personal_sign mode in sign_text_message to correctly prepend "\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" + length + message as per EIP-191.
item.acceptance: Test in tests/ctc/binary/test_signatures.py should pass for test_sign_text_message.

item.description: The standardize_transaction function needs to properly handle field mappings and ensure consistent transaction formatting across different transaction types, particularly for EIP-1559 transactions.
item.contract: Improve the transaction standardization logic to ensure proper field mapping and handling of different transaction types (legacy, EIP-2930, EIP-1559) by ensuring correct conversion of field names and values.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/ctc/evm/test_transaction_utils/test_transaction_utils.py should pass for test_sign_transaction.

item.description: Several CLI commands are failing due to missing or incorrect command specifications in the command_index, preventing the CLI examples from running successfully.
item.contract: Ensure all CLI subcommands have proper command specifications with required attributes (help, examples) to make them runnable. Update the command_index to ensure all commands have valid specifications.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/ctc/cli/test_cli_subcommands.py should pass for all CLI examples.
